| | Peter— Inflation is at a 40-year high. GDP has declined for two straight quarters – the textbook definition of a recession. And countless Americans are struggling to make ends meet. So how do Washington Democrats’ respond? By passing a massive new **tax-and-spend bill** deceptively titled the “Inflation Reduction Act.”
---
[**END SINGLE-PARTY DEMOCRAT RULE**](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=fe728d2547c842b2950d802752a13f33&_e=KydBtvzxaLtqf3-PynGMqRkDKcs7G5oZ-lgusVE9IVdOHkTytZqNszCIdYwW7e9m6JX1OUYx49KZAXLLJI0Cnx5wnnWg248kX9EH3W6br0RwKQeAie5u5iNJVsRm_3d5g34ax2QDaCr5ADGX2Av7x-6ycCWFO6RcGAcZDXJCkn4EX4mkEMnQhQeaC81KoMbFqsYr1F60jTDZNmqE4Z0h7Cc-7xlqserx0rI-vz1yML-kVX1VEYbxVDZ-KQt7pj4C-nQuMcibwemWa7-poCeGGdto8qDNzPAIeC5aQHbzeY2ts4X02wLoH3HZWxue9001qsIDVtiEJLA_rx0deliSJ5u8-EbDpXQQk9jOLbAKOPXJOGSybX8rRPFTZzqUYCR2Gv3y_luf80PX3iVBH12At8JcOazOofnFejDZDGYeZoVQPrXDlk_msLVpc_HIuyLBhvSBgvYWOPNSAMgeyjq9C8KcSsvIZZyf1kg9gZ1GOS0%3D)
---
This Orwellian bill does **NOTHING to reduce inflation**. But it does: ❌ Impose billions in **new taxes** on middle class Americans.❌ Create an **army of 87,000 (!!) new IRS agents** to increase audits**.** ❌ Divert $400 billion of taxpayer money to **“green” special interests**. ❌ Impose **socialistic price controls** that will increase drug costs and harm R&D.;
---
[**STAND WITH ME**](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=fe728d2547c842b2950d802752a13f33&_e=KydBtvzxaLtqf3-PynGMqRkDKcs7G5oZ-lgusVE9IVdOHkTytZqNszCIdYwW7e9m6JX1OUYx49KZAXLLJI0Cnx5wnnWg248kX9EH3W6br0RwKQeAie5u5iNJVsRm_3d5g34ax2QDaCr5ADGX2Av7x-6ycCWFO6RcGAcZDXJCkn4EX4mkEMnQhQeaC81KoMbFqsYr1F60jTDZNmqE4Z0h7Cc-7xlqserx0rI-vz1yML-kVX1VEYbxVDZ-KQt7pj4C-nQuMcibwemWa7-poCeGGUx6XaSW_tjxrNTRceXphwnaZ92qHh9iUFT6FS0A_8UhcRYpb76SJZq0E865oRqxXOuG9shK0Vi1zuiZDszR4LbIyA7P2sT5IrHWah79kVYEzQ6FI_wZEJtkIbkHIevrVEHVwNcn9RC0-0-FkBXDlXLuLRqIMcxmjdLU9Wsk0RjBbiBZsmtvuSpR8JNwrOEXi-xea1eauD3_3RSpQ2zEwmI%3D)
---
It’s no surprise that my Far Left opponent – 30-year career politician Julia Brownley – enthusiastically supported this bill. After all, she votes 100% of the time with Biden and Pelosi.

Peter, as a top Republican supporter, I wanted to let you know how we are laying the groundwork to win the midterms in less than 100 days.

**Exceptional ground game.**

If you’re wondering what that means, let me explain. The RNC is recruiting thousands of volunteers to knock doors and make phone calls in communities across the nation.

Essentially, our unmatched data-driven ground game and a grassroots army of volunteers is spreading the Republican Party’s message in every community across the country!

Our commitment to engage with voters at the community level is how we will take back the House and Senate this November. Elections are won on the ground, which is why I am emailing you today. Peter, as a top Republican supporter, I wanted to let you know how we are laying the groundwork to win the midterms in less than 100 days.

**Exceptional ground game.**

If you’re wondering what that means, let me explain. The RNC is recruiting thousands of volunteers to knock doors and make phone calls in communities across the nation.

Essentially, our unmatched data-driven ground game and a grassroots army of volunteers is spreading the Republican Party’s message in every community across the country!

Our commitment to engage with voters at the community level is how we will take back the House and Senate this November. Elections are won on the ground, which is why I am emailing you today. [**Outreach efforts come with a price tag, and we need some fundraising support to ensure we have enough in the bank to cover our costs for the next three months.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=342cd971ffd145b0887737b151aeaf49&_e=Ab2v3TJIdRnDNHtIv6ZYoYPu_hI7Bnfps8fDi80w-pCTIpyREJ8uLfziodDDoiYSfbVrx_b3J4oyJsVL08nLHbm1oZAAw5GWQN4uYLZvM5iyRZk0G7l28wIWltAM_xWYmq563Ub43a7zstubkEge0_D6UDSnwDcnEtBLXP4_LoXgwJuLsI7sNLH5oivTkU9nM82hs5TIxh-i8RfVOgzW6p3FA8twN_K10r3PlrKiEWbzz7_qtFn0zsLECsAEXlJczPK3jdsMUsvB1US09Yaw0jKUtxlpM322LQjriykFSYsxtHcAgJNsza0EXjTqFFgud226NhuccMa2-B-BcZemcGO-nF2XFxdtPzHSb38efMfjVUNugwTAi6LA6DKo_CYCXY-3HJsrKtvPufwbFEvorMSXdHthLG-coRBZdgjskBHLiHeu4rqi0IdmgxWZ9izJ07vtjI1aE7rkc_60s0yw_FlPm38gI6BGET81M41r1aK2WcBjgpjoHbHgYjDENwBfWbP8x3_oOyizAVS50WDS-A%3D%3D)

[** Fuel our Outreach efforts >> **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=342cd971ffd145b0887737b151aeaf49&_e=Ab2v3TJIdRnDNHtIv6ZYoYPu_hI7Bnfps8fDi80w-pCTIpyREJ8uLfziodDDoiYSfbVrx_b3J4oyJsVL08nLHbm1oZAAw5GWQN4uYLZvM5iyRZk0G7l28wIWltAM_xWYmq563Ub43a7zstubkEge0_D6UDSnwDcnEtBLXP4_LoXgwJuLsI7sNLH5oivTkU9nM82hs5TIxh-i8RfVOgzW6p3FA8twN_K10r3PlrKiEWbzz7_qtFn0zsLECsAEXlJczPK3jdsMUsvB1US09Yaw0jKUtxlpM322LQjriykFSYvRQNmxBwY2CbRaoBebRW-iqpFZ5Khj6wfFNwB8zLMfaF1vTFTHaVWDqpIS2-np-3w01FWtUXElGBl9_1zUjA1XqWfGhIsowrVFaikyuGlwyuXX7ZGbTSLeyDoIcNz7M2TEzSnBDStaogxNkdEHmfwha-uPp-SxLahLDUFHTjBLAzbdcHjrcCLB1yyTYXv0ZoszxFEaPEsokeWcBAebw2T1UhRxL7ohwYBaemQFvNIkUQ%3D%3D)
We are also ramping up our minority outreach, opening over 30 community centers geared toward minority voters. _****_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

Today, thanks to your hard work, we did it!
Wyoming has spoken on behalf of everyone all across this great country who believes in the American dream, who believes in liberty, and who recognizes that our natural rights -the freedom of speech, freedom of religion, equal protection and due process, come from God, they do not come from the Government.
And what Wyoming has shown today is that while it may not be easy, we can dislodge entrenched politicians who believe they’ve risen above the people they’re supposed to represent.

Wyoming has spoken on behalf of everyone all across this great country who believes in the American dream, who believes in liberty, and who recognizes that our natural rights -the freedom of speech, freedom of religion, equal protection and due process, come from God, they do not come from the Government. And what Wyoming has shown today is that while it may not be easy, we can dislodge entrenched politicians who believe they’ve risen above the people they’re supposed to represent. By our vote today, Wyoming has put the elites on notice - we are no longer going to tolerate representatives who don’t represent us. | Wyoming has drawn a line in the sand that if WE put you in power, you WILL be accountable to us, you WILL answer to us, and you WILL do what is in OUR best interest. That is why when I am representing you, I will not waste any time. I will fight every day to block the destruction of our country. | Today we have succeeded at what we set out to do – we have reclaimed Wyoming’s lone congressional seat for Wyoming. I want to thank all of our wonderful friends – new and old – those volunteers knocked doors from here in Cheyenne, in Casper, all of our County Leadership Teams, all of the 40,000 plus donors in Wyoming and across this great nation. Thank you, | | Harriet Hageman | | | | |

**Harriet Hageman wins big in Wyoming GOP primary**
---
Harriet Hageman, Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, tonight scored a tremendous victory over incumbent Rep. Liz Cheney, decisively winning the Republican primary election and reclaiming the state’s only House seat for the people of the Cowboy State. Hageman ran on her record as a constitutional attorney protecting individual liberties and property rights for Wyoming citizens, pledging that in Congress she will always remember who hired her for the job. Hageman stood in stark contrast to Cheney, who was obsessed with her personal vendetta against President Donald Trump, despite loud criticisms from citizens that she had abandoned her responsibility to represent Wyoming’s interests. Hageman will now proceed to the general election in November, where she is expected to win again in a state that gave President Trump 70 percent of the vote in 2020. Trump endorsed Hageman on the day she entered the race in September 2021 and held a rally in support of her in Casper in May of this year. Hageman celebrated her victory with family and hundreds of supporters at Cheyenne Frontier Days on Tuesday night. Biden is a dictator-in-waiting and I need your help to ensure I make it to Congress and stop him and the Deep State before it's too late. **[Please ACT TODAY and help me win!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61018769:6bD5hyVGN:m:1:3325945326:81577D4ECFE84100D930A4EEF7EB2963:r "Please ACT TODAY and help me win!")** For liberty,

name: Tom Brejcha
subject: They hurled paint bombs at my home
body:
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg6k9e9cfmdct92b0uqag0tdg09ohu4a6ipdcr6g_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctj60ob3c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf2s35e2q78tb3cur69oblcdr70pj1m5qm4ori64rjbc73m9oe0phjear38sjkm1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9o6ccbimdg6fchmcoqm1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
| | | Dear Fellow American, As a leader in the pro-life movement, I’m urgently reaching out to folks like you who believe in life, liberty, and the rule of law to join me in a special mission. [**Will you help me hold accountable members of the radical anarchist pro-abortion group “Reproductive Justice Union” for their attacks on my family and other pro-life advocates?** ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zou279mp4o06psrngad809p9truv67iub1nk6v1o_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctj60ob3c5h2bs) Please, allow me to explain... My name is Tom Brejcha and I’m the president and founder of the Thomas More Society, a non-profit law firm dedicated to defending life, family, religious liberty, and election integrity. Perhaps you recognize my name from our work representing David Daleiden in his high-profile court battles with Planned Parenthood, the National Abortion Federation, and the state of California. In the days following the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade,_ “Reproductive Justice Union” made credible threats against me on Twitter. They “doxed” me, distributing flyers revealing my home address with my face front and center, highlighting all the things I’ve done to defend the right to life for preborn babies and our other shared values throughout my career.

---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z784pq8h9761p2es776i1ia1st4ltqmbccdr7030_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctj60ob3c5h2bs)
---
And finally, on July 1st, they attacked our home. As police looked on, 40-50 thugs from “Reproductive Justice Union” gathered in front of my home screaming obscenities about me, the pro-life movement, and the Supreme Court. _**They tore up an American flag, shouting “Death to America,” and uprooted my wife’s beloved rose bush.**_ Then suddenly they launched loud smoke bombs, surged onto the lawn, and hurled paint bombs at our home. Fortunately, my wife and I were not home. We are safe and sound. But our property is not. The beautiful brick house — the home where my wife Debbie and I raised our two sons — is stained with indelible green paint. Worse, the “F” word, anarchist symbols (circled capital “A”), and ugly slogans like “No God, No Rulers” and “Abort the Supreme Court” cover our driveway and sidewalk. We've hired a series of experts to remove and/or paint over this graffiti, but some of it still won't come off. [**That’s why I’m asking you to make a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100 or more to help the Thomas More Society hold these****criminals accountable — all while we******](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi9t0mh7tdsg7c84h3kj0810ea8ov1tqltl2fvp0_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctj60ob3c5h2bs)[**continue defending life in court battles across the country**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr6ftoi9rc95cja35fr5ce8camrtcj89m7mpo6a8_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctj60ob3c5h2bs)**.** You see, thanks to the Twitter threats against us earlier that week, we had just beefed up our home security system with new cameras. We also hired detectives who photographed the pro-abortionists' cars and license numbers. So, we may be able to identify and track down several suspects, one or more of whom drove up to our north suburban Chicago home from Missouri. Yet not one person has been held accountable. That’s right. As of now, no criminal charges have been filed. Sadly, I’m not the only target of radical pro-abortion activists in the aftermath of the _Dobbs_ decision. Pregnancy centers and churches alike have suffered vandalism and even arson at the hands of groups like “Reproductive Justice Union,” “Jane’s Revenge,” and other anarchist groups. **But these thugs cannot intimidate the Thomas More Society.** If the district attorneys don’t bring charges against the criminals responsible for the damage at my home and others, then we are prepared to file civil lawsuits! My friend, we must put a stop to these attacks, identify all of the perpetrators, and hold them accountable — so please do not delay. [**Please follow this link to donate $35, $50, $100 or more today.** ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl89qa09pk8dsvobkqpnps1dj30aab08loo7i8h0_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctj60ob3c5h2bs) Mark my words: This is not the end of the violence we’ll see from the radical abortion lobby. In fact, I expect it will only escalate. We must be prepared to fight back and show “Reproductive Justice Union” and all seeking to intimate and harm us that we will not take their attacks sitting down. [**So, I pray you’ll find it in your heart to help the Thomas More Society fight back by making a tax-deductible donation or $35, $50, $100 or more.** ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhg1bammnamvinosa3hpdev9ersjcfd3dsufmt9o_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctj60ob3c5h2bs) Thank you for standing with me to defend life and the rule of law. May God bless you,
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfnamm0ke4aurn56ni1c7l19n6u9ntbf58r0vq9g_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctj60ob3c5h2bs)
---
Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel
---
P.S. Now that _Roe v. Wade_ is gone, pro-abortion anarchists are focusing their energy on trying to intimidate the pro-life movement into giving up the fight to defend preborn babies in every state. If these radicals are bold enough to openly attack a private residence in a quiet neighborhood, despite significant police presence, there’s no telling what they’ll do in the dead of night to pro-life pregnancy resource centers or pro-life advocacy groups and churches in cities and downtown areas. [**Your tax-deductible gift of any amount today will help ensure the Thomas More Society has the resources on hand to fight back with civil lawsuits to hold these criminals accountable**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zphfqpcr66lvsml2cm0tuq6v9c6jpmumo7lri4v8_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctj60ob3c5h2bs) — while continuing to defend our dozens of existing clients in critical courtroom battles across America. Thank you!

Team, I hate to come to you with bad news, but I need to keep you in the loop. Here's the deal: our fundraising has really slowed down, and now **we're falling behind.**
And it couldn't have come at a worse time. Our pre-primary FEC deadline is just ONE WEEK away — and every dollar we've raised this quarter will go public. Once that number is out, the GOP will know exactly how strong (or weak) our campaign is ahead of the general election.

Catherine will fight for women and families
We Can Trust Catherine to Deliver
Catherine has spent nearly a decade in office delivering results for families across Westchester by never backing down from a tough fight. In a world where those in power often expect women to step aside, Catherine has routinely stepped up to lead – and the results speak for themselves. Her experience in navigating complex legislative matters has resulted in a better quality of life across all of our communities.
We know Catherine will fight for women and families in Congress because she’s done so her whole career.
As the Democratic Majority Leader for two years and leading Legislator for the Westchester County Board of Legislators, Catherine helped pass groundbreaking laws empowering and protecting women, families, and communities of color, including:
* CO-SPONSORING the Clinic Access Bill which protects women as they seek reproductive healthcare in Westchester
* FIGHTING for and securing earned sick leave in Westchester so caregivers can take care of their families and not have to worry about losing a paycheck
* BANNING questions on job applications regarding salary history which disproportionately affects women
* PASSING a resolution supporting one of the strongest extreme risk protection order laws in the country to keep women and children safe from abusers, showing the way for New York state to take its stand with women
* BANNING conversion therapy for minors
* FIGHTING for and securing funding for the creation of the Center for Racial Equity
* PASSING the Immigration Protection Act
Join the thousands of women and their families across the district voting for Catherine on August 23rd, because sometimes you just need a woman to get the job done.

subject: This isn’t the end
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY REPUBLICAN ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT, A PROJECT OF DEFENDING DEMOCRACY TOGETHER
body:
|
---
Friend,

I wish I was sharing better news, but if you haven’t already heard, Rep. Liz Cheney lost her primary last night to Trump-endorsed MAGA loyalist Harriet Hageman. It’s a crushing loss for all of us who want to see more figures in the Republican Party fight back against Trump’s influence. But instead of wallowing in the sadness of her defeat, we should all remember Cheney’s statement following her loss: that “freedom must not, cannot, and will not die here.” Liz Cheney knows our democracy is too important to give up. The fight will continue, and Cheney will still be a leader in it. She’s going to have all of us at RAP backing her. And most important of all, she’s going to have all of you with her in the fight too. Sarah Longwell Executive Director, Republican Accountability Project

name: Kristin Hurley - Peter Hernandez for Congress
subject: Recap from Monday's Volunteer meeting
body:
Hi Vote For Pedro volunteers!

Peter and Joe ran the meeting on Monday....thank you to those
who were able to join in!

Here is what was discussed:

_**\- We have to prioritize canvassing.** Everyone was sent an invite to
_
_our volunteer kick off event with Liz Lawler for this Saturday. The_
_flyer is attached here. We encourage everyone to join in there for_
_training and practicing (hitting the streets).
_
_
_
_**\- Joe and I will be calling everyone this week** to see who is committed_
_to canvassing. We are dividing the areas by_
_San Jose
Morgan Hill
Gilroy
Salinas
Watsonville
Aromas
Hollister
Castroville_
_So we need people to commit to those areas and we 'll form teams this_
_week and connect the volunteers. Kristin and Joe will be in communication_
_with the area teams and get everyone set up on how to use Catch The Vote_
_or other walking lists.
_
_
_
_**\- Door hangers and some flyers** will be distributed to the area canvassing crews,
_
_stay tuned for that._
_
_
_**\- We 'll get everyone set and trained** in their area groups and then we hope the_
_precincts can be covered during evening and weekend hours. We 'll eventually have_
_goals and better metrics once we get going.
_
_
_
_**\- We are still building the phone banking volunteers**. Please let us know if you
_
_find anyone else that wants to make phone calls. Michael Hogan is in Scotland
_
_for a few weeks but we have Jim Ferguson ready to train and sign people up. We_
_would also like to follow up with volunteers who are making calls to make sure_
_they are comfortable with the system and have their questions answered. Let us_
_know if you need more training or need help.
_
_
_
_**\- Signs need to go up.** We have 4x4 signs going up and will have tons more yard_
_signs very soon. Please help us by putting some up in your areas. I can deliver
_
_signs to volunteers in each area of the district and then you can help distribute. Please_
_let me know if you can help out in this way.
_
_
_
_**\- Where to join us for upcoming events:**_
_Sat Aug 20th 9-11am Volunteer Kick off Morgan Hill flyer attached_
_Sun Aug 21st 9-12 San Jose Great mall Farmers Market_
_Sun Aug 21st 1-4pm Santa Cruz GOP BBQ in Watsonville - tickets needed_
_Sat Aug 27th 10-1pm San Jose Vietnamese Cultural Community Event_
_Sun Aug 28th 9-4pm Aromas Day festival Aromas - we have a booth and it 's lots of fun_

Please let me know if anyone has any questions!
Thank you!
Kristin

\--

Kristin Hurley
Campaign Manager
Peter Hernandez for Congress
CA District 18
831-254-5606

| Dear Peter,

As you know, my fundraising was from grassroots donors like you. We are seeing more and more independently wealthy and self-funding campaigns, and they have agendas. My agenda is always to work for the people. But fundraising has been slow. People are strapped in this economy. We understand donations have been down in every campaign, so my team and I have been working every day, budgeting and stretching every dollar to reach every voter and supporter. I need your help, though, before I file my campaign FEC report. If I run again, I want to make sure my campaign is not in debt from running against 2 of the worst far-right extremists in Congress. I am tired of the corruption and arrogance of my opponents these past 4 years, Paul Gosar and David Schweikert. I worked my ass off these 4 years going around Arizona and talking with voters. I'm tired of the personal attacks and sly remarks. I need your help to defend myself against these attackers and far-right extremists. I need to send a message to my opponents that I still have my supporters on my side to ensure I do not have campaign debt and will be back to fight for democracy and our progressive values another day. Are you with me? Can you help me meet our goal of $5000? Do you have a few dollars to chip in today? As always, thank you for all your encouragement and support!-Delina

body:
Derek,
I’m emailing to ask you to split a donation of $25 between my campaign and CommonGood. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220817_CGVA_Franken]
Here’s why: The polls show me neck and neck with Chuck Grassley – and according to the latest Des Moines Register poll, Grassley is quickly losing support while we are gaining ground.
I know $25 might not sound like much, but that’s how we’ve been building momentum and made Iowa one of the most competitive Senate races in the country. With tens of thousands of people like you giving even just $25, we’ve built a powerful grassroots campaign.
But Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are determined to stop us and defeat me at any cost. They know that if we turn Iowa blue, Democrats are guaranteed to hold onto the Senate. That’s why I need you now to help me defeat Chuck Grassley.
I’ve set a goal to raise $50,000 before our midnight fundraising deadline, but we’re still $19,737 short. And with Grassley just launching a new round of attack ads to defeat me, we cannot afford to fall even one dollar short.
Since you started reading this email, another four people will have already donated their $25 to help me win, but I’m counting on you to chip in now too.
Please, this cannot wait. Will you split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood – our average donation is $28.79 – before this critical midnight deadline to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220817_CGVA_Franken]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220817_CGVA_Franken]
When we defeat Chuck Grassley and win this race in November, it’ll be because of grassroots donors like you chipped in today.
Thank you so much,
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)

| | Dear Friend, We’ve done something new.

We’ve created a free online teaching series that combines the learning of an online course with the features of a documentary.

That’s why when you watch the trailer for our newest free online teaching series, “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ,” you’ll notice that your professor, Dr. Laffer, is accompanied by Larry Kudlow, Steve Forbes, Amity Shlaes, and others. Together they explain the fascinating history of economics in America and what is required to restore economic freedom and prosperity to our great nation.

I’d like you to be one of the first people to preview this new series. **You can watch your video and pre-register for the new series below:**

---
In this free teaching series, Presidential Medal of Freedom recipient Arthur Laffer—famous for the Laffer Curve and for advising President Ronald Reagan—provides answers to fundamental questions about the core areas of macroeconomics—taxation, money, government spending, regulation, and trade—and how government policies in these areas either promote or hinder the growth of the economy.

In each episode, you’ll learn from Dr. Laffer, as well as:

* **Steve Forbes** , Chairman and Editor-in-Chief of Forbes Media.
* **Stephen Moore** , distinguished fellow in economics at the Heritage Foundation and author, with Art Laffer, of Trumponomics: Inside the America First Plan to Revive Our Economy.
* **Brian Domitrovic** , economic historian and author of Econoclasts: The Rebels Who Sparked the Supply-Side Revolution and Restored American Prosperity.
* **Larry Kudlow** , former Director of the National Economic Council under President Donald Trump.
* **Amity Shlaes** , chair of the board of the Calvin Coolidge Presidential Foundation and best-selling author of The Forgotten Man: A New History of the Great Depression.
* And, **Larry P. Arnn** , President of Hillsdale College.

This free series could not be timelier, given our current economic situation. In this free series, you’ll learn how private citizens drive the economy and you’ll discover the role economic incentives play in unleashing prosperity—timeless lessons in human nature and economics that are common sense to most Americans, but appear lost on many in our academic and political “elite.”

**[So, after watching the trailer, I hope you’ll be one of the first to join us by pre-registering for this free online series.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2b20c5ea7c134f21b6f506b5a7edb392&_e=wuhMKTuSQr6rCql5PTqHf-m7KINnms7fr_8Q8rl1m7OaR43jXIu05N5bB_qEa45kF8yLo4PpM_QT8REFVW9dC0J_rcFi1Ex4QwiQQKQrdjFdCraPLMWMkRkXGMllXRYFND8cLeS01EraaF3x2SFQsg4iwsSCQ6da4z7dxbeg5cJqsIcAKzNuh4sjSYY6kXEi6Tpl7CUdCNfqemJ_nvalZE40VMikhsAZn5-z0y2M5GvKMGx3HJ4BA91Lz7FWsFKXoZeqEJ6h5e3ERQhWP1GBIdxdccCL_8IoaewqM-PIIoOnqTwCLarL3vKfij30qSmFcRsGUKgNoHywxvwLTuU06vHqCOYpnnfCA80Ig7pjz44sV9zDAeqwL-mCOOQBCHVEdIyvMpDOloZPB6JPcGNEWKmKr7cwSaztHSUfCxLcrKq7cEtGgJec8E0pprv_oNW9pIb_dcXf841GfT2FymDgSKbwg6MFqHVMA-xFLj0hTZo%3D)**

Americans across the country like you are looking for answers to our current economic condition. But, as Dr. Art Laffer explains, good economic policy is not complicated, and you can learn why.

Pre-register for “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ” today!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** There’s one more thing: After you pre-register, will you also consider giving a special tax-deductible gift to help promote “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ” to millions of Americans nationwide?

Your generous gift will help us promote this course and our other educational efforts, like _Imprimis_ and our classical K-12 education programs.

As you may know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding—even indirectly in the form of federal or state student loans and grants. That means this series and everything else we do here is only possible because of our generous supporters.

name: Jon Kaiman
subject: Supporting our essential workers.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Kaiman for Congress
body:
Peter,
Yesterday, I was honored to meet with maintenance workers of the Le Havre on the Water Co-op in Whitestone, Queens. Last week, I met with workers at the Beech Hills Co-op in Douglaston. Co-ops are a vital part of our community's housing that could not function without the service of these union members.

I am proud to have the support of the members of 32BJ SEIU, the largest union representing property service workers in the United States. For the entirety of my government career, I have supported these essential workers and will continue to do so as the representative of NY-03.

Unions are critical to our economy, as well to the workers. Unions are at the forefront of improvements in health care, standards in the workplace and benefits that enable women to work. Unions help ensure workers and their families live in dignity and to uphold protections for workers enshrined in law and through collective bargaining. As your representative in Congress, I will continue to uplift these unions and ensure their voices are always heard.

Save the 13 million Americans covered under the Affordable Care Act nearly $800 a year on health insurance premiums.

Create a brand new, out-of-pocket cap on costs for prescriptions for seniors — including capping insulin costs at $35 a month for beneficiaries in Medicare Part D.

Allow Medicare to negotiate down many prescription drug prices.

Take the most aggressive action in Congressional history to combat the climate crisis, create climate jobs, and put us on track to reduce carbon pollution by 40% by 2030.

Hello,
When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful.
People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ **I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened.**
They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service.
**And worst of all, they attacked and denigrated every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, and sometimes spend holidays thousands of miles away from each other.**
Now, I’m taking on an even greater challenge. And in my campaign to defeat Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, things are going to get even nastier. I am sure of it, because control of the Senate hinges on our race and whether or not we can turn Iowa blue.

name: Chrissy
subject: Making progress for PA-06
body:
Pennsylvania's 6th District. Chrissy Houlahan for U.S. Congress.
chrissyhoulahanforcongress.com

A NOTE FROM CHRISSY:

With less than 100 days until Election Day, I've been spending time connecting with voters in Pennsylvania. It's always an honor to hear from you, and I appreciate you sharing the issues that matter to you most. As we move full speed to the finish line, I want to catch you up on what my team and I have been working on the last month:

MODERNIZING K-12 STEM EDUCATION:

I firmly believe that Americans should have access to quality, affordable education. That's why I introduced the Mathematical and Statistical Modeling Education Act, which aims to modernize the teaching of K-12 STEM courses. As a teacher and co-founder of the Congressional Women in STEM Caucus, I know firsthand how vital these skills are in preparing the next generation to perform cutting-edge research and further our nation's scientific enterprise. I'm happy to share that the House passed my bill with broad bipartisan support.

[READ MORE] - https://patch.com/pennsylvania/phoenixville/houlahan-s-stem-education-bill-passes-house

DELIVERING ON PROMISES:

I was proud to vote for the Inflation Reduction Act, which will have a terrific impact on Pennsylvania families. It lowers the costs of health care and prescription drugs. It makes CRUCIAL investments in clean energy, which create jobs and lower our utility bills. And it does this while lowering the federal deficit.

OUR 64TH TOWN HALL:

To date, I have held more town halls than any member of the Pennsylvania delegation - and I have no plans of slowing down! Hosting town halls is one of the best ways for me to hear from you about what's important and to share what I've been working on. Last week, we focused on inflation, which is a critical issue facing our community. If you were not able to join, you can click here to listen to the recording.

https://houlahan.house.gov/uploadedfiles/mainconf-recording-cl18354-id75080-n321-c228_220727163053.mp4

DEFENDING REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOMS:

With the overturning of Roe v. Wade, it's become clear that certain rights and protections we trusted were settled law are, instead, up for grabs. I was pleased to see my colleagues, both Democrats and Republicans, vote to protect marriage equality and access to contraception. Congress must act now before the Supreme Court reverses more of its previous decisions, putting more lives and more families at risk.

A STEP CLOSER TO OUR SUPPLY CHAIN SOLUTION:

Our district is not only home to multiple semiconductor manufacturers, but we have some of the best manufacturers in the world right here in Pennsylvania. So I'm excited to say that the CHIPS and Science Act passed the House 243-187, and it's now been signed into law. The bill will support domestic chip production, grow our STEM workforce, bolster domestic 5G capabilities, and expand cutting-edge research and development through the National Science Foundation. I'm proud of this legislation and will continue to reach across the aisle for the good of our community, Commonwealth, and country.

[READ MORE] - https://www.mychesco.com/a/news/government/chips-would-help-semiconductor-makers-in-pa-nj-and-ny/

I hope you were as excited about these updates as I was about sharing them with you. The incredible progress we're making for our district isn't possible without the support of people like you, so thank you.

I'm eager to bring you more good news from my office as we continue to fight for change in PA-06 and across the nation. Until then, please do not hesitate to contact our office with any issues you would like to discuss.

There is work to be done.

- Chrissy.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk645-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

We have fewer than 100 days until Election Day. With so much hanging in the balance - from voting rights to reproductive freedom - holding the line in key races like PA-06 is our last defense against our MAGA radical opponent who is working to take our district backward. Chrissy will need all the resources she can get to fight back and win. So we need to ask:

Will you make a donation to help reelect Chrissy to Congress? Your support will make such a difference in our work to defend this seat and keep the House blue.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk645-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

This Fall, we are launching [Sheridan Bible Institute](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=13915629.7840.1.ebb957e1fb221c56e06fab65dcc2676d)! This will be a _one-year program_ designed to **educate** , **equip** and **empower** believers to bring about **real transformation** to our nation. Each semester will consist of six courses. The classes will take place on Tuesday and Thursday evenings starting at 6 pm CT. There will be three classes on Tuesday evening and three classes on Thursday evening with each class being fifty minutes. For the Fall semester, I will be teaching **Old Testament Survey** and **History of Christianity Pt.1**. The other courses will be taught by Instructors that I know have _studied to show themselves approved_. If you would like to **dive deeper into the Word of God** then I want to encourage you to checkout [Sheridan Bible Institute](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=13915629.7841.1.6488c4d307914d3d665e6907ab63dbe2). Each class will be streamed live online as well as uploaded with a link for our online students. The pricing is **TOTALLY** affordable. Tuition is only $300 per semester (around $100/month). This is an investment that I guarantee will bring about a great return in your life. To learn more and to apply visit: [www.sheridan.church/bibleinstitute](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=13915629.7843.1.07a08bc3e8d4da32e76fe6f93927a7b0)

body:
Blake Masters won the Republican primary with the help of a multi-billionaire who’s spending $15 million via a Super PAC for him.
#

Friends —
Blake Masters won the Republican primary with the help of a multi-billionaire who’s spending $15 million supporting him via a Super PAC.
And if he wanted to, he could probably dive into his money cave to spend ten times that in the general election against Mark.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-aug22.Iyxc-M&refcode=em220817-1-7&t=1&akid=3572%2E6688874%2Ex0Z6GT)
But we do things a bit differently. Mark’s campaign is funded by people like you who have made contributions when you can, of whatever you can afford.

name: Deroy Murdock
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhcg865mjqbblkjggtgc61hru0fgti97ql5qfrp8_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctimaor6chh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbrbedjje1o7apj3mhor9dj36iqr4phmclgr9odjcpr76dj761r3epdhemr6ac9nmv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664rj6p9ge8qmcc9imdgefc5lclp2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z2o38meegbalg9r8pok5p5kum6si5lpp2babnpr8_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctimaor6chh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zepce6rkvpan3tocre47u9bdbee8u680mn21fut0_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctimaor6chh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zv56ltsbhvl1kc1lqkt8qis55uqe2qtdcppp5fpo_rp22sh2s8i66or0ctimaor6chh2bs)** Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

name: EMERGENCY ALERT
subject: [ALERT] Almost 1,000 Rockets fired on Israel
body:
The Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town in Israel is on high alert!

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026137:JK9_xyVNs:m:1:3331421248:7C768D1E1956A5FECDD377702B1AECE9:r "Headline") Peter: If you're following the news, you know this the people of Israel have endured a few tough days and more may be coming. The Iran-backed Islamic Jihad released a barrage of nearly 1000 rocket attacks targeting Israeli citizens. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026137:JK9_xyVNs:m:1:3331421248:7C768D1E1956A5FECDD377702B1AECE9:r "Phone")**These rockets have been fired at Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, and other Israeli cities. These attacks have taken place day and night, disrupting sleep for most Israelis who must seek immediate shelter.** **As I write you, the Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town is on high alert!** **These acts of terrorism are increasing by the day. Even when it's quiet after a cease-fire, the threat of more rockets and trauma from the past rockets remains. That 's why I am asking you to help us raise $45,798.25 by midnight tonight so we may:**
* Provide emergency aid backpacks for local Israeli security forces.
* Comfort terror victims suffering from PTSD especially young children.
* Care for soldiers who put their lives on the line to protect their people and the Land.

**[Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly appreciated.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026137:JK9_xyVNs:m:1:3331421248:7C768D1E1956A5FECDD377702B1AECE9:r "Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these
emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly appreciated.")** We definitely need prayers, but we also need financial help so the Genesis123 Foundation can fulfill its mission and aid those who have suffered as a result of these rocket attacks. Most of Israel's youth (including my son) put their lives on the line defending the State of Israel and by playing a vital role in the War on Terror that threatens Israel, the United States, and our allies. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026137:JK9_xyVNs:m:1:3331421248:7C768D1E1956A5FECDD377702B1AECE9:r "Soldiers")Unfortunately, often these soldiers do not have all the supplies they need, and often times their families have to buy them supplies out of their own pockets. Sadly, this isn't an option for soldiers who don't have family or the means to support them, so the Genesis 123 Foundation fills that gap while they keep defending Israel, safely and with dignity. During this Summer's extreme heatwave, one of the ways we help is to provide cold drinks, sweet watermelon and ice cream, and anything else we can, to help ease the soldiers' burdens. And let me tell you, these cool refreshments in the hot Summer sun are a well-received relief to these soldiers. **[Whether it's to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026137:JK9_xyVNs:m:1:3331421248:7C768D1E1956A5FECDD377702B1AECE9:r "Whether it’s to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in
Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!")** Please prayerfully consider how you can help us take care of all the people affected by these Iranian-backed terror attacks. Don't delay. The next attack may occur in a matter of days as the Islamic Jihad is already threatening to break the ceasefire. The people of Israel need to be ready to respond to the emergencies and trauma that will result from the next attack, and that's why we need your generous support TODAY! Whether it's 10 or 1,000 rockets, the lives of innocent women and children are at risk. **We need to make sure the soldiers defending Israel have all they need, and we can provide other resources to Israelis who have suffered from these attacks.** **[Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000 today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a result of these terrorist attacks.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026137:JK9_xyVNs:m:1:3331421248:7C768D1E1956A5FECDD377702B1AECE9:r "Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000
today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a
result of these terrorist attacks.")** Thank you again for your prayers and support. May God's blessings be upon Israel, Jonathan Feldstein
President, Genesis 123 Foundation

> PRESS RELEASE
Canceled by Harvard, Mansharamani takes on the Woke Cultural Revolution

---
CONCORD, NH - August 17, 2022 - Today entrepreneur and U.S. Senate candidate Vikram Mansharamani released his latest ad, taking on his cancelation by Harvard and the Woke Cultural Revolution that is ripping the country apart. He is seeking to end the divisive identity politics that is strangling America.
"The ideals of the American Revolution are being replaced by a Woke Cultural Revolution," said Mansharamani. "They are tearing down statues of George Washington, teaching that America is irredeemably evil, and telling our kids they should pick their own gender. We need to take a stand and stop this nonsense." Mansharamani went on to note how a diversity of ideas is critical to a well-functioning society, and the identity politics of the day is putting us on a path towards socialism. "We've moved from a focus on equality of opportunity for all towards a quest for equity of outcomes."
As reported by the Union Leader, Mansharamani used to teach a class at Harvard and was also being considered for a new professor position. name: EMERGENCY ALERT
subject: EMERGENCY ALERT
body:
The Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town in Israel is on high alert!

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026218:6s87eyVNl:m:1:3317145305:B9D85906AFC6F4CB4AF44E5F5E154316:r "Headline") Peter: If you're following the news, you know this the people of Israel have endured a few tough days and more may be coming. The Iran-backed Islamic Jihad released a barrage of nearly 1000 rocket attacks targeting Israeli citizens. [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026218:6s87eyVNl:m:1:3317145305:B9D85906AFC6F4CB4AF44E5F5E154316:r "Phone")**These rockets have been fired at Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, and other Israeli cities. These attacks have taken place day and night, disrupting sleep for most Israelis who must seek immediate shelter.** **As I write you, the Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town is on high alert!** **These acts of terrorism are increasing by the day. Even when it's quiet after a cease-fire, the threat of more rockets and trauma from the past rockets remains. That 's why I am asking you to help us raise $45,798.25 by midnight tonight so we may:**
* Provide emergency aid backpacks for local Israeli security forces.
* Comfort terror victims suffering from PTSD especially young children.
* Care for soldiers who put their lives on the line to protect their people and the Land.

**[Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly appreciated.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026218:6s87eyVNl:m:1:3317145305:B9D85906AFC6F4CB4AF44E5F5E154316:r "Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these
emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly appreciated.")** We definitely need prayers, but we also need financial help so the Genesis123 Foundation can fulfill its mission and aid those who have suffered as a result of these rocket attacks. Most of Israel's youth (including my son) put their lives on the line defending the State of Israel and by playing a vital role in the War on Terror that threatens Israel, the United States, and our allies. [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026218:6s87eyVNl:m:1:3317145305:B9D85906AFC6F4CB4AF44E5F5E154316:r "Soldiers")Unfortunately, often these soldiers do not have all the supplies they need, and often times their families have to buy them supplies out of their own pockets. Sadly, this isn't an option for soldiers who don't have family or the means to support them, so the Genesis 123 Foundation fills that gap while they keep defending Israel, safely and with dignity. During this Summer's extreme heatwave, one of the ways we help is to provide cold drinks, sweet watermelon and ice cream, and anything else we can, to help ease the soldiers' burdens. And let me tell you, these cool refreshments in the hot Summer sun are a well-received relief to these soldiers. **[Whether it's to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026218:6s87eyVNl:m:1:3317145305:B9D85906AFC6F4CB4AF44E5F5E154316:r "Whether it’s to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in
Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!")** Please prayerfully consider how you can help us take care of all the people affected by these Iranian-backed terror attacks. Don't delay. The next attack may occur in a matter of days as the Islamic Jihad is already threatening to break the ceasefire. The people of Israel need to be ready to respond to the emergencies and trauma that will result from the next attack, and that's why we need your generous support TODAY! Whether it's 10 or 1,000 rockets, the lives of innocent women and children are at risk. **We need to make sure the soldiers defending Israel have all they need, and we can provide other resources to Israelis who have suffered from these attacks.** **[Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000 today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a result of these terrorist attacks.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026218:6s87eyVNl:m:1:3317145305:B9D85906AFC6F4CB4AF44E5F5E154316:r "Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000
today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a
result of these terrorist attacks.")** Thank you again for your prayers and support. May God's blessings be upon Israel, Jonathan Feldstein
President, Genesis 123 Foundation

Hey Peter Willis,
**The choices around a person's reproductive rights should be left up to the individual, and access to healthcare shouldn't be limited by income or what state you live in.**
Right now, just being a "Pro-Choice" Democrat isn't enough. We need pro-choice champions who will fight for our equality and accept nothing less.
I’ve organized marches, rallies, teach-ins and protests in my community for protecting reproductive rights. I know first hand how hard this battle is. Even in “blue” states like New York, we need to show up and fight for reproductive justice.

# Combat climate change? It could be time to privatize orphaned oil wells
---
| The Inflation Reduction Act has just committed $350 billion to combat climate change. The Act, approved by Congress last week, also contains provisions to penalize companies that produce excess methane gas, a key contributor to global warming.

“Great!” you might say. “At last something serious is being done about greenhouse gasses.”

If we are serious about cutting methane emissions, before beating up on business or clamping down on cows, we should be looking to do something about the tens of thousands of government owned oil and gas wells that lie abandoned across America.

Why? These orphan wells, drilled by businesses that have long since ceased to operate them, are one of the biggest sources of methane emission. Publicly owned, but for practical purposes simply abandoned, many of them have been cheerfully spewing out methane for years.

According to the Mississippi State Oil and Gas Board in our state alone “there are roughly 23,500 wells with a plugged and abandoned status or those which have no associated operator”. Some of these are effectively sealed, but an unknown number are not. According to industry insiders, there are an estimated 400 wells drilled between 1940 and 1970 which may or may not have been plugged but no such records can be located.

If even a fraction of Mississippi’s 23,500 old wells are leaking methane, they collectively account for a serious amount of methane over the years.

[Research ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=85c68a2c47&e=5703353baa)conducted by Amy Townsend-Small, a geology professor at the University of Cincinnati, found that idle oil wells emit an average of 6.2 grams of methane per hour, although some have emissions as high as 132 grams per hour. Multiply that by the number of leaky wells, and the number of years they have sat abandoned, and you soon have a serious source of methane pollution.

No doubt if government bureaucrats were required to tackle a pollution problem caused by wells that the government owns they would devise a costly program in response. But what if there was a no-cost alternative that could fix the problem instead?

Orphan wells are able to carry on emitting methane because they are publicly owned. As Aristotle once suggested, that which no one owns, nobody cares for. Or as Milton Friedman more recently echoed, “when everybody owns something, nobody owns it.”

Today, oil companies have almost no incentive to plug orphaned wells that they do not own. In order to get them to cap uncapped wells you would need to literally pay them, or force them to set aside funds to do so at the outset of any new exploration.

But what if you aligned the interests of oil companies with those that want to see the wells properly sealed? Why not allow oil companies to buy up bundles of orphaned wells? Instead of sitting there ignored and unloved, you could allow private businesses to buy them in return for a promise to take care of them. Privatized wells would have to be either properly plugged, or else reactivated.

Over the past few decades there have been some remarkable advances in oil extraction technology. 3-D seismic imaging and developments in horizontal drilling mean that fields which were long ago considered exhausted have been brought back into production, with often striking results.

Auctioning off bundles of orphaned wells could work if oil companies were allowed to use new extraction techniques in old fields. Any business contemplating whether to bid for a bundle of old wells would have to weigh up the cost of having to cap any that were unproductive with the potential gains from additional extraction.

Instead of having to wait for federal bureaucrats to take the initiative on this, this is a policy proposal that states like Mississippi could take themselves. Mississippi should consider passing a law to allow publicly owned orphaned wells to be bought by private firms, on the understanding that they are either capped properly or brought back into production.

Perhaps this would not provide sufficient incentive for private firms to want to incur the cost of capping for an uncertain return on wells that might be brought back into production. Maybe additional incentives are needed to encourage private enterprise to cap them. I have no doubt that this idea could be improved upon.

But the best way to reduce methane emissions is by creating incentives that get private enterprises involved. Allowing private firms to buy orphan wells might just do something about methane emissions, while raising more tax revenue for our state, creating more work for oil workers, and providing more energy for America.

body:
|
---
| | | Patriot,

The antics this week have made one thing painfully clear: **there will be no justice while Democrats are in power. **
**First,** Democrats used their power to try and raise taxes on Americans.

**Then,** Democrats used their power to raid President Trump's Mar-a-Lago home.

**Now,** my biggest extended deadline of the year is here and if I fall short, the Democrats will continue to abuse their power.
---
| | | [I WILL STEP UP AGAINST THE DEMS >>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026982:6VozqyV8N:m:1:3299561967:034FE8971358C9DC5089EFA2C10CA1C3:r "I WILL STEP UP AGAINST THE DEMS >>>")
---
Patriot, we are three months out from the election and I will be honest - if we don't reject these hypocrites and get them out of the Senate, things will only get worse.

Things are not good right now. Polls show I'm tied against a Trump Impeachment Manager and I've been outraised every quarter. Not to mention, the smear campaign from my opponent is relentless. **I cannot stress this enough: if I miss my extended deadline tonight, it will be a nightmare for the conservative cause.**
---
| | | [HELP MARCO REACH HIS GOAL](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026982:6VozqyV8N:m:1:3299561967:034FE8971358C9DC5089EFA2C10CA1C3:r "HELP MARCO REACH HIS GOAL")
---
We need people to come together to demand accountability for Biden and the Democrats. We need people to come together to take away the power that they use to shield themselves from scrutiny.
---
| | | [I WILL JOIN THE FIGHT>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61026982:6VozqyV8N:m:1:3299561967:034FE8971358C9DC5089EFA2C10CA1C3:r "I WILL JOIN THE FIGHT>>>")

So please, join the fight. Reject these crooks and their bad ideas.

Thank you,
Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |

I'm starting to get nervous because I am one of the most vulnerable Republicans up for re-election this November and Pelosi knows that if the Dems defeat me, they will have full access to pass their liberal agenda.

**The Filibuster will be abolished.

Speech will be censored.**

**And conservatives will be silenced.**

Until recently, the state Department of Corrections "[barred the state's parole officers from seeking criminal charges against convicts who escaped from halfway houses.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AJNJd_2AWGX1bop-ISzzNl11l3JeAYUouTIxvJ_wS8xKRpgWM0jPzwzXHKyP0HcQ7U4aLQHWcvQePzX6GE2e0GDEOsW1K5YsX-ggd3FL-MjTt99GDK0s3fYzO968n6zOVXe9nFzLhVXSIzKD4G9UdOJp6qM54glSyjNM9dhphQd4nRLYgEj8KhyO4JOLgngJjdT_yZxiDwuwdSfSG0wogdYtYMYSOwzOIU_feEZdnY72CiNJEmR-S7sQLlYZ3-7o7gC_hn6w02lsIpDPYk69EGq-Iux2WCGw&c=n5rPPFmEM2N9PvHuQ58M46BT1-xeIhhNOUSutrrPJ5rca651d1KZ3w==&ch=ayXF9DKuchZDu-TwkmcGL2cQHJQkqnV258VsRb-ZF1LfQwRZLwgPNg==)" It was only when the radical policy was exposed that this dereliction of duty was ended. Many state governments are enacting no-cash bail, which enables criminals to almost immediately leave a booking office following arrest and return to the streets to commit more crimes. Severely reduced sentences for even violent crimes, combined with inaction by district attorneys, are causing crime rates to rise.
This lawlessness further extends to states and municipalities that label themselves as sanctuary governments. They ignore federal law and their own statutes as uncontrolled mass migration brings violence, human trafficking, and drugs to their communities.
If no change is made, fear will overtake our towns and cities as citizens realize they no longer have the protection of their elected leaders.
To turn back from this destructive path, we must turn our thoughts to the victims of crime.

We cannot design laws that are focused on anyone other than the offender. The safety of our citizens depends, in part, on criminals being aware that their criminal activity may result in punishment. Preventing and prosecuting offenses should be the first course of action. Instead of hampering law abiding citizens and business owners' freedoms, the police and municipal governments should work to keep their communities free of bad actors.
The federal government can assist communities by helping local and state governments to ensure adequate police presence in neighborhoods in our country. Many police programs have federal funding, and we must tie that funding to action and reporting that enables congressional oversight. Attempts to defund local and state police forces must be met with a federal requirement that any use of federal law enforcement funding must be focused on personnel and equipment and cannot be diverted to unrelated programs. Federal dollars should not continue to go to rogue governments that are choosing to ignore the rule of law.
| | |
---|---
|
To remedy this self-inflicted rise in crime, our state and federal legislators must act out of compassion for the people who suffer when crimes are committed. A Republican majority in Congress can lead the way in returning sensible, responsible, and just governance to our law enforcement and criminal justice systems.
As your representative, I will always put the safety of our citizens first, upholding the rule of law and ensuring justice is served. On my watch, we will make our streets safe again.

We cannot allow this to continue.

As a Congressman, I will uphold the respect our service members and first responders deserve, get veterans the help and assistance they need, and make sure residents in district 7 feel safe and secure once again.

I am so thankful to local law enforcement, service members and veterans and hope they know that when I am in congress, I will make their needs a top priority.

Vote Now for Nassau Legislator Carrie SolagesEarly Voting has officially started; it’s time for New Yorkers to head to the polls and cast their vote for the August 23rd primary.**Nassau County Legislator Carrie Solages is on the ballot. He is running to be your next congressman representing NY 4th Congressional District.** Your early voting polling site may differ from your election day location. To find out your early voting polling site, [**check here**](https://solagesforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60f879846c19417c4bab5220c&id=0ae92a92e6&e=0c821b2b94). Nassau Residents may vote at any early voting location. Remember, the last day to vote early for the August primary is Sunday, August 21st.
On August 23rd, vote from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. at your election day polling site. [**Find your Election Day polling place, and confirm your party registration here**](https://solagesforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60f879846c19417c4bab5220c&id=6d2f8c16c3&e=0c821b2b94).
If you know of individuals who would like to receive this update, [**please have them sign up here**](https://solagesforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60f879846c19417c4bab5220c&id=297d593f8a&e=0c821b2b94).
_**Early Voting Hours in Nassau County**_**Vote Early Today until Sunday, August 21st** Wednesday, 8/17, 10 am to 7 pmThursday, 8/18, 10 am to 7 pmFriday, 8/19, 10 am to 6 pmSaturday, 8/20, 9 am to 6 pmSunday 8/21, 9 am to 6 pm
**Nassau Residents may vote at any location:**

**What’s more, the _Inflation Reduction Act_ will represent the single largest climate investment in American history. It’s a big deal.**

[I’m ready to go to Congress to keep delivering results on climate, just like I’ve done as California Assembly Speaker pro Tem. Could you chip in $20 right now to help me get there?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=6b1a8889f6&e=292fde286a)

In the Assembly, I created _OneShoreline_ through legislation, bringing all levels of government together in San Mateo County to fight sea level rise, and I helped pass the largest climate action package in California history, a massive $15 billion investment to address wildfires, droughts, sea level rise, and carbon emissions.

Together, we’ve made California the national leader on climate policy, and we’re only getting started. In Congress, I’ll be ready on Day One to build on this record of results that make a difference in addressing the climate crisis, so that we leave a cleaner and healthier planet for our children.

[But I first need to build the resources to win this election in November. Can you chip in $20 to help send me to Congress so I can push for more bold climate action?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=c5e267d457&e=292fde286a)

Thank you for your continued support,

Kevin Mullin

There are more than 100 candidates currently running for office who openly peddle the “Big Lie” conspiracy theory that the 2020 Presidential election was stolen.

That conspiracy theory has been used to justify a nationwide, systematic attempt to manipulate the electoral process against the majority, with GOP-controlled legislatures passing voter suppression laws to make it more difficult for Black and other minority voters to exercise their right to vote!

**Now, as we celebrate the 57th anniversary of the Voting Rights Act of 1965 that banned racial discrimination in voting, we need Congress to take action, NOW, to protect our voting rights – and the Senate, in turn, should get rid of the filibuster in order to get it done.**

[Add your name here if you agree.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49375399/361890369/1268064495?refcode=JJ_EM_PT_90DO_220817_1_1&refcode2=e37c02af-681e-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&contactdata=fPC%2BPFjjAm%2Fbgln4z0iCXuKnLWUqo1VbyFGsk3SZfqjNpV9PoBp8TeJAwxf%2FZ7rDO9CWSUpmLdRPxBAOTWN%2B2A%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzdjMDJhZi02ODFlLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Djib64KiJNp9DljzpGfTEbBnxwr_PptlynGEd2nbKEk=&emci=d27c02af-681e-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=e37c02af-681e-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9019239)

Over the last decade, the increasingly-conservative Supreme Court has chipped away at the protections of the Voting Rights Act, paving the way for extremist legislators to enforce racial gerrymanders and other hurdles to voting.

__Next term, the Court will hear arguments in an Alabama case that explicitly targets the Voting Rights Act and the fundamental right of ALL Americans to vote.__

I have worked for years to advance voting rights in Illinois and nationwide. We know that the restrictive voting laws passed in GOP-controlled states across the country don’t just hinder the electoral process in those states, but in fact injure democracy for all of us.

**Voter protections are the bedrock of any democratic society. Without them, our democracy cannot stand.**

[That’s why I’m asking you to join me in calling on the Senate to eliminate the filibuster in order to pass the Freedom to Vote Act and the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49375400/361890370/1268064495?refcode=JJ_EM_PT_90DO_220817_1_1&refcode2=e37c02af-681e-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&contactdata=fPC%2BPFjjAm%2Fbgln4z0iCXuKnLWUqo1VbyFGsk3SZfqjNpV9PoBp8TeJAwxf%2FZ7rDO9CWSUpmLdRPxBAOTWN%2B2A%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzdjMDJhZi02ODFlLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Djib64KiJNp9DljzpGfTEbBnxwr_PptlynGEd2nbKEk=&emci=d27c02af-681e-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=e37c02af-681e-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9019239)

I am proud that Illinois has passed some of the most inclusive voting laws in this country – from provisions for early voting and automatic voter registration to reinstatement of voting rights after time served in prison and jail. In fact, applications to vote by mail in the November 8 General Election are already open to registered Illinois voters.

**It is long past time we secured some of the same voter protections nationwide.**

Thank you for making your voice heard to preserve our democracy,

Jonathan

Friend, I need you to take this to heart: I've never backed down from standing up to Donald Trump, Mitch McConnell, and their Republican allies.
But here's the reality: My efforts to hold them accountable have made me a target for defeat. Now, Trump has not only weighed in directly on Connecticut's Senate race, his personal choice has just won the GOP primary and officially become the Republican nominee. In other words, the stakes for this race just got even higher.
With the entire GOP establishment lining up to hand control of the Senate back to Mitch McConnell, let me be clear: We can't afford to miss a single fundraising goal. But right now, we're $10,500 short of where we need to be this month.
When it comes to protecting Democratic Senate control, I know $10,500 may not seem like a big deal. But I promise, it makes a big difference - especially at this moment in our campaign. Every last dollar we raise right now matters _immensely_ when it comes to fighting back against the GOP's attacks and protecting this seat.
**[So please, ahead of my next big fundraising deadline, can I count on you to ensure we hit this goal so I can defeat my Trump-endorsed opponent and protect control of the Senate? Click here to rush a donation of $5 or more right now to keep this seat and the Senate blue.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1235-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
With your support, I know we can win this race, keep this seat blue, and protect (and expand!) Democratic control of the Senate.
Thanks for all you do,
Dick

name: Diehl for Governor
subject: I want to set the record straight
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DIEHL FOR MASSACHUSETTS
body:
| | | |
---
| Friends,
I want to set the record straight, once and for all.
First, I did not get into this race to help the Boston Globe -- one of the nation's most liberal newspapers -- sell its left-wing propaganda to readers.
Let's face it. The Globe never has anything positive to say about Republicans, including me. I've been the bane of their editorials for years, simply because I have the courage to stand up and express views that don't fit their liberal talking points.
So earlier today I publicly rejected an invitation from their editorial board to "interview" for the Globe's endorsement. Their editorial page is essentially just a bulletin board for left-wing progressive talking points and utopian daydreams, and I'm not playing into it.
---
| | [Read Geoff's Full Statement About the Globe](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qnixCcZsekF2DwjqQ-DXG9erUzU-QdMIaeW1RwPY188FIfXYL1o0b_Q5fgZsRdalNdb9ROds0EDN1uJ_j4LXJYnsN1V-2nwyX9bylc8yoIotb6baMuWYYjLaTyxJx3Iu8mo5u-6lLXtUL1Fcy-8i_OTn-eOJIZYfqseP1yMFQDvS8Lb38ay4y2nJi9wTBgsTlYyqqfwEZB5QEAzL2uS3ovKrWQtg6yCYrBOuFy0-i48=&c=PcgJmf7Cjq2teUBVQSYsjAbmfntpvsix6cMVcwmHbnwZOVvnKYbvVg==&ch=Ba6LkL23GmzJ92DQYLdSbDpccqTINV7mhRhiFALTRppLOLoWn9t_bg==)
---
| Second, I did not get into this race to help my opponent, who has no record because he's never run for public office, raise his political profile with free air time.
I challenged my opponent to two debates as soon as we both qualified for the ballot. He accepted one invitation, and we debated -- for a full hour, live on The Howie Carr Show, in front of studio guests and with a prime drive-time audience listening.
My opponent failed to accept a second debate, on the Jeff Kuhner Show. I'm not one to renege on my promises, so I kept the scheduled appearance and took questions from Jeff Kuhner and his listeners live, on-air for more than an hour. I was happy to do it and we got a great response. You can hear the whole thing here:
---
| | [Listen to Geoff Diehl on The Kuhner Report](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qnixCcZsekF2DwjqQ-DXG9erUzU-QdMIaeW1RwPY188FIfXYL1o0b_Q5fgZsRdal4w0XfoN70VfUqCUWjO4bSqLxsgo_3X9_GGNnQfzURfN_SsJzZrWZCe8X8dbiDDAYOh-a6K-1GmXJRF6D5n66QNT9FMQ1Av5sQYw2AUk9v1HEZn7fjJ90QJKoNHbQciyxPVgXDU5PL0bIDQCd8Uz10N9kCcFiGppbrtKOiYFvWRlOpuz8bDg5uJzn4ulGisc5WwqE1pVQ_YeUv8IMIw6ysU6uguIAh4sA&c=PcgJmf7Cjq2teUBVQSYsjAbmfntpvsix6cMVcwmHbnwZOVvnKYbvVg==&ch=Ba6LkL23GmzJ92DQYLdSbDpccqTINV7mhRhiFALTRppLOLoWn9t_bg==)
---
| I think my opponent now realizes his bad tactical error because he keeps calling for more and more pre-primary debates -- ten in all! (Lincoln and Douglas, who made political debates famous, only needed seven debates to resolve the presidency!)
Look, my opponent had a full hour to say whatever he wanted to, and he declined another hour of debate to further state his case. If he now feels he missed his shot, that's not up to me to fix, and it doesn't do the voters any service to fight about it.
I am running for exactly one reason: to protect and enhance your freedom and prosperity. I consider anything that doesn't further that cause to be a distraction and a waste of your time. I'm not pandering to the Globe or my opponent.
This race isn't about newspaper endorsements, debates, or slick television ads. It's about who is going to protect your freedom, cut taxes, stand up against mandates, educate your kids, and fix our broken transportation systems. I sincerely believe my experience in the public and private sectors, together with my lengthy conservative track record, uniquely qualifies me for the job. I'm the most electable candidate in this race. I've won 5 races in a row. My opponent has 0 wins.
The latest polling has us leading this race three-to-one. Leah Allen and I won the Republican Convention's endorsement two-to-one. Now, I'm working hard to bring our message to you, one-on-one. I don't need a filter or a moderator to help me out.
I'm not giving in, and I'm not backing down. Leah Allen and I are here to fight for you, the People of Massachusetts.
That's the real story, straight from me. Don't accept spin from anyone to the contrary. Leah and I are here to win this race and to lead Massachusetts forward in 2023.
In victory,
---
---

name: John Fetterman
subject: I’m SORRY
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
The Republicans are spending big because PA is a must win for them to steal the majority.
#
Before I start.... TO ALL OF MY FELLOW PENNSYLVANIANS:
I’m sorry.
If you’re watching TV over the next few months, you probably won’t see anything but attack ads with movie trailer voice overs and my head of luscious hair. 🙄
**I just got a report back from our media team and look at this TV spending graph — we’re getting outspent by nearly double over a seven week period.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220817-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220817-6892&refcode2=6892_434096_i6pNEA&akid=6892%2E434096%2Ei6pNEA)
If the election were held today, I would feel good about our chances. But after months of misleading attack ads, we just don’t know how the polls might move.
So, I’m asking for your help again. Because **_we can’t afford to be outspent_** — especially when control of the Senate comes down to how we do in PA.
**[Can you chip in $5 to close the gap and ensure we have the money to match the attack ads thrown at us? Every dollar helps us shrink that spending gap so PA voters can hear from ME instead of only the Republicans.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220817-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220817-6892&refcode2=6892_434096_i6pNEA&akid=6892%2E434096%2Ei6pNEA)**
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220817-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220817-6892&refcode2=6892_434096_i6pNEA&akid=6892%2E434096%2Ei6pNEA)**
If you’ve seen some of the ads the GOP has been running, you would get why I’m nervous about being outspent. I mean the guy they’re running against... I don’t recognize him at all. They’re making all these wild claims about me and what I believe.
In the last midterms, 83% of the Senate races were won by the candidate who spent the most money. So, even though these Republican ads are completely wacko, we can’t just let them run free and not respond with our own message.
[**_So please, if you can, make a $5 donation to close the spending gap between us and them. It’ll make a big difference in our ability to tell the positive story about our vision for PA to more voters._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220817-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220817-6892&refcode2=6892_434096_i6pNEA&akid=6892%2E434096%2Ei6pNEA)
Thank you. 🙏
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220817-1?refcode=em20220817-6892&refcode2=6892_434096_i6pNEA&akid=6892%2E434096%2Ei6pNEA)**
